name: Venti
quote: Feel on your skin the breaths of spring, herald of freedom, and the bane of kings.
description: A carefree, wine-loving bard who is secretly Barbatos, the Anemo Archon and god of freedom presiding over Mondstadt. Having helped found the nation, he stepped back from direct rule and now wanders the world, only intervening as an Archon in times of great need.
